title: Declare every initial Cargo input on the train

facts.note: Fires when a planner authors or edits a train definition file.

values: set of artifacts seeded into Cargo before step 1 changed
facts.note: Diff-level observer needed to detect a new train or changes to the train's inputs block / the set of artifacts that may be seeded into Cargo.
Task wording referencing train authoring or Cargo seeding.

fires: Planner authors a new train for which any artifact may be seeded into Cargo (caller-provided or materialized from the spec), including seeded artifacts that no wagon reads.
Planner edits a train so that the set of artifacts that may be seeded into Cargo before step 1 changes.
Planner adds or removes entries under the train's inputs.caller or inputs.spec_materialized.
doesNotFire: Planner edits a wagon's internal acceptances without changing which artifacts may be seeded into Cargo.
Documentation or planning work that does not touch a train definition.
Artifacts produced by an earlier wagon step within the train (those are not initial inputs).

given: A train definition for which any artifact may be seeded into Cargo before the first wagon step, whether or not a wagon reads it.
when: The planner authors or edits the train.
then: Declare every artifact Cargo may be seeded with under inputs.caller (caller-provided) or inputs.spec_materialized (deterministically materialized from the spec).
prefer: Classify each initial artifact explicitly: caller-provided goes in inputs.caller; anything derived deterministically from the spec goes in inputs.spec_materialized.
Mark which initial inputs are required so missing ones can be rejected before step 1.
avoid: Relying on an undeclared artifact being present in Cargo at train start; undeclared initial inputs are rejected before step 1.
Leaving a required initial input unsupplied or unmaterialized; missing required initial inputs are rejected before step 1.
Placing non-deterministic or caller-supplied data under inputs.spec_materialized.
why: Cargo is seeded and validated before the first wagon step, so the journey can only start from declared initial inputs; undeclared inputs or missing required initial inputs must fail fast before step 1 rather than mid-sequence.
evidence: The train definition contains inputs.caller and/or inputs.spec_materialized listing every artifact seeded into Cargo.
Every artifact that may be seeded into Cargo before step 1 appears in inputs.caller or inputs.spec_materialized.
Running the train with an undeclared initial input or a missing required initial input is rejected before step 1.
verifier_detail: Declared initial inputs = inputs.{caller, spec_materialized}; seeded into Cargo and validated before the first wagon step.

Reject before step 1 when Cargo is seeded with an artifact not declared in inputs.caller or inputs.spec_materialized, or when a required declared initial input is missing. Absent optional inputs are not grounds for rejection.
Binding is pending: the validator is owned by D2 (#1086); until bound, compliance is established by review of the train definition.
audit: Pending binding - validator owned by D2 (#1086).

additions.text: Mark which initial inputs are required so missing ones can be rejected before step 1.
additions.justification: Source rejects 'missing required initial inputs', which presupposes required-ness is knowable; made explicit as a preferred planner move, not a new obligation.

additions.text: Placing non-deterministic or caller-supplied data under inputs.spec_materialized.
additions.justification: Restates the source's definition of spec_materialized ('deterministically materialized from the spec') as an anti-pattern for planners.

additions.text: Activation facts, fires and doesNotFire cases including the exclusion of artifacts produced by earlier wagons.
additions.justification: Required by schema; derived from the term definition (seeded before the first wagon step).

additions.text: Until bound, compliance is established by review of the train definition. Absent optional inputs are not grounds for rejection.
additions.justification: Clarifies verification while the validator binding is pending, and makes explicit that the source's rejection covers only missing *required* inputs.
